title: Cody Rhodes Reflects on His WWE Return and Embracing Healthy Competition
htmlContent:
On a Tuesday night at the premiere of his upcoming Peacock documentary, "American Nightmare: Becoming Cody Rhodes," the former WWE superstar Cody Rhodes made media rounds, sharing insights into his wrestling journey and his thoughts on his WWE return. The documentary is set to be released on July 31st, giving fans a glimpse into the life and career of this iconic wrestler.

Speaking with Denise Salcedo of Instinct Culture, Rhodes opened up about his WWE comeback and whether it lived up to his expectations. He admitted to being somewhat surprised by the experience, especially after having taken pride in executive roles and managing aspects of wrestling outside the ring. However, Cody's true passion lies in being a wrestler, and the overwhelming response from WWE fans made his return even more remarkable.

Rhodes expressed genuine gratitude for the opportunity to return to WWE and witness firsthand the magnitude of the audience and the unparalleled reach of the brand. Wrestling at a grand event like WrestleMania in Dallas was a humbling experience for him, as he had initially anticipated a negative reaction from the crowd due to being the secondary character in a storyline. Contrary to his expectations, the fans embraced his return with open arms, understanding the purpose of his comeback, and appreciating his contribution to the event.

The wrestler admitted that he has been fortunate throughout his journey and feels blessed with the success he has achieved. Despite not knowing how his WWE return would unfold, the outpouring of support and acceptance from the fans surpassed his expectations, making it an enriching and rewarding experience.

When asked about the toughest part of his wrestling career, Cody shared insights into the modern wrestling landscape. He acknowledged the healthy competition among wrestlers in the current generation, emphasizing that it fosters growth and improvement. Unlike the past, where politics often played a significant role, today's roster comprises seasoned professionals who have evolved through various wrestling promotions.

Cody highlighted the positive aspects of competing against top-tier wrestlers like WWE World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins. He praised Rollins as one of the best in the business and explained how their friendly competition elevates their performances and brings out the best in both of them. This collaborative spirit and genuine camaraderie among wrestlers have contributed to the success and popularity of today's wrestling landscape.

In a world where competition can be cutthroat, Cody Rhodes embraces a healthy rivalry that pushes him to constantly improve and deliver his best in the ring. By appreciating the accomplishments and skills of his fellow wrestlers, Cody proves that true success comes not just from individual achievement but from embracing the collective spirit that drives the wrestling industry forward.

As fans eagerly await the release of "American Nightmare: Becoming Cody Rhodes," they can anticipate gaining deeper insights into the life and career of this wrestling icon. Cody's journey is a testament to the power of passion, determination, and embracing healthy competition, serving as an inspiration for aspiring wrestlers and fans alike.
